camel_example: aliyun eci CreateVirtualNode --region cn-hangzhou --Tag.1.Key name --ZoneId 'cn-hangzhou-b' --ResourceGroupId 'rg-uf66jeqopgqa9hdn0000' --CustomResources 'example1.com=100,example2.com=200' --ClusterDomain 'example.com' --SecurityGroupId 'sg-2ze81zoc3yl7a3we0000' --VSwitchId 'vsw-2ze23nqzig8inprou0000' --TlsBootstrapEnabled false --EnablePublicNetwork false --ClusterDNS '100.1.XX.XX' --EipInstanceId 'eip-uf66jeqopgqa9hdn0000' --Taint.1.Value testValue --Tag.1.Value test --KubeConfig JTVDbmFwaVZlcnNpb24lM0ElMjB2MSU1Q25jbHVzdGVycyUzQSU1Q24tJTIwY2x1c3RlciUzQSU1Q24uLi000000 --RegionId 'cn-hangzhou' --ClientToken '123e4567-e89b-12d3-a456-426655440000' --Taint.1.Key testKey --VirtualNodeName testNode --Taint.1.Effect NoSchedule
description_en: Creates a virtual node to connect a self-managed Kubernetes cluster to ECI and scale out resources
description_zh: 创建一个虚拟节点（VNode），用于对接自建Kubernetes集群，使其可以扩展资源到ECI
kebab_example: aliyun eci create-virtual-node --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --zone-id cn-hangzhou-b --security-group-id sg-2ze81zoc3yl7a3we0000 --vswitch-id vsw-2ze23nqzig8inprou0000 --virtual-node-name testNode --resource-group-id rg-uf66jeqopgqa9hdn0000 --client-token 123e4567-e89b-12d3-a456-426655440000 --enable-public-network false --eip-instance-id eip-uf66jeqopgqa9hdn0000 --kube-config JTVDbmFwaVZlcnNpb24lM0ElMjB2MSU1Q25jbHVzdGVycyUzQSU1Q24tJTIwY2x1c3RlciUzQSU1Q24uLi000000 --custom-resources example1.com=100,example2.com=200 --cluster-domain example.com --cluster-dns 100.1.XX.XX --tag Value=test Key=name --taint Value=testValue Effect=NoSchedule Key=testKey --tls-bootstrap-enabled false --region cn-hangzhou
name: CreateVirtualNode

parameters.help_en: The ID of the security group. The virtual node and the ECI instances in the virtual node are added to this security group
parameters.name: zone_id

parameters.help_en:
The ID of the vSwitch used by the virtual node and the ECI instances on the virtual node.
You can specify 1 to 10 vSwitches that belong to the same VPC.
parameters.help_zh: 安全组ID。虚拟节点以及该虚拟节点下的ECI实例将加入到该安全组中
parameters.name: security_group_id

parameters.help_en: The name of the virtual node. The name must be 2 to 128 characters long and can contain lowercase letters, digits, periods (.), and hyphens (-)
parameters.help_zh:
交换机ID。虚拟节点以及虚拟节点下的ECI实例所使用的交换机。    
支持指定多个（1~10个）属于同一VPC的交换机。
parameters.name: vswitch_id

parameters.help_en: The ID of the resource group
parameters.help_zh: 虚拟节点的名称。长度为2~128个英文字符，可以包含小写英文字符、数字、半角句号（.）或者短划线（-）
parameters.name: virtual_node_name

parameters.help_en: Ensures the idempotence of the request. The client generates a value for this parameter. You must make sure that the value is unique for each request. The value can contain only ASCII characters and must be no more than 64 characters long. For more information, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/25693.html
parameters.name: resource_group_id

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to enable internet access. The default is false.
If set to true, the virtual node is assigned a public IP address.
parameters.help_zh: 保证请求幂等性。从您的客户端生成一个参数值，确保不同请求间该参数值唯一。只支持ASCII字符，且不能超过64个字符。更多详情，请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/25693.html
parameters.name: client_token

parameters.help_en: The ID of the Elastic IP Address
parameters.help_zh:
是否支持公网。默认为false。    
如果设置为true，则虚拟节点将对外暴露一个公网IP
parameters.name: enable_public_network

parameters.help_en: The KubeConfig of the Kubernetes cluster to which the virtual node connects. The value must be Base64-encoded
parameters.name: eip_instance_id

parameters.help_en:
The custom resources supported by the virtual node. If an ECI pod declares a corresponding custom resource in its request, the pod is scheduled to the virtual node.
The format is `resource name=resource count`. Use a comma to separate multiple resources
parameters.help_zh: 虚拟节点要连接的Kubernetes集群的KubeConfig。需进行Base64编码后传入
parameters.name: kube_config

parameters.help_en: The domain name of the cluster. After configuration, Kubelet configures all containers to search this domain name in addition to the host's search domain
parameters.help_zh:
虚拟节点支持的自定义资源。如果ECI Pod的request中声明了相应的自定义资源，则该Pod会被调度到VNode。
格式为`资源名称=资源数量`，多个资源之间使用半角逗号间隔
parameters.name: custom_resources

parameters.help_en:
The IP addresses of the DNS servers. If `dnsPolicy=ClusterFirst` is set in an ECI pod, the pod uses these addresses for DNS.
You can specify multiple IP addresses. Separate them with commas
parameters.help_zh: 集群的域名。配置后，除了主机的搜索域外，Kubelet会配置所有容器来搜索该域名
parameters.name: cluster_domain

parameters.help_en: The tags for the virtual node. You can specify a maximum of 20 tags
parameters.help_zh:
DNS服务器的IP地址。如果ECI Pod中设置了`dnsPolicy=ClusterFirst`，则使用该配置值为容器提供DNS服务。
支持配置多个IP地址，多个IP地址之间使用半角逗号间隔
parameters.name: cluster_dns

parameters.help_en: You can add up to 20 taints to the virtual node
parameters.help_zh: 虚拟节点标签信息。最多可以配置20个
parameters.name: tag

element_fields.help_en:
The effect of the taint. Valid values:
- NoSchedule: Pods cannot be scheduled to the tainted node.
- NoExecute: Pods cannot be scheduled to the tainted node, and existing pods on the node are evicted.
- PreferNoSchedule: Pods are preferentially not scheduled to the tainted node
element_fields.help_zh:
污点的Effect。取值范围：

NoSchedule：不将Pod调度到具有该污点的节点上。
NoExecute：不将Pod调度到具有该污点的节点上的同时，驱逐节点上已经存在的Pod。
PreferNoSchedule：尽量不将Pod调度到具有该污点的节点上
element_fields.name: effect

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to enable TLS bootstrapping. If this feature is enabled, the KubeConfig certificate is used for TLS bootstrapping. Valid values:

true: Enabled

false: Disabled

Default: false
parameters.help_zh: 虚拟节点污点信息。最多可以配置20个
parameters.name: taint

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to enable TLS bootstrapping. If this parameter is enabled, use the KubeConfig certificate for TLS bootstrapping. Valid values:
- true
- false
Default value: false
parameters.help_zh:
是否启用TLS启动引导。启用后，请使用TLS启动引导的KubeConfig证书。取值范围：

true：启用
false：不启用

parameters.name: tls_bootstrap_enabled
